OTECH TL560A-1 +10dbM Optical Power Meter with VFL 

The handheld optical power meter is an instrument which are used to measure the magnitude of optical power. The fiber optic power meter can be used for both direct measurement of optical power and relative measurement of optical attenuation. With the rapid development of fiber optic communication technology, fiber optic communication has become the main transmission for various communication networks. Optical power is one of the most important parameters for evaluating the performance of optical terminal equipment and evaluating the quality of fiber optic transmission. The optical power meter price is competitive and Stable VFL Output

Features

  • Self Calibration
  • Self Auto Off
  • High Accuracy, high ,High sensitivity, high linearity-
  • Stable VFL Output
  • Set the REF Value Real-time display of the power consumption
  • Interchangeable connectors: FC/ SC
  • Rubber Out shell, increased the protective properties for field work

Specifications

  • Range Type: -70～+10 
  • Wavelength 800～1700nm
  • Calibrated Wavelength 850/1300/1310/1490/1550/1625nm
  • Resolution 0.01dBm
  • Working Temperature ℃ -10～+50
  • Storage Temperature ℃ -20～+70
  • Humidity 90%（＋30℃）
  • Connector FC/SC(ST LC as optional )
  • Power Supply 2pcs AA batteries
  • Battery Life @ OPM 140hours
  • Battery Life @ VFL 50hours
  • Auto-off 10minutes
  • Weight 180g
  • Dimensions 158×82×29mm
  • VFL Curly hair: 650nm
  • Output Power: 1mw
